quests.name: Caught!
quests.text: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Ledger from Tanaris
quests.text: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Key to Freedom
quests.text: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

quests.name: The Horn of the Beast
quests.text: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.

quests.name: Suntara Stones
quests.text: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.

quests.name: Suntara Stones
quests.text: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in Ironforge. He is in the Hall of Explorers.

quests.name: Divine Retribution
quests.text: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.

quests.name: The Flawless Flame
quests.text: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: Forging the Shaft
quests.text: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
quests.text: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.  The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

quests.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
quests.text: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

quests.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
quests.text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.  The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Fiery Menace!
quests.text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.  Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.

quests.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
quests.text: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.  You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.  Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

quests.name: Prayer to Elune
quests.text: Hear Zamael tell his tale.

quests.name: Prayer to Elune
quests.text: Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Flame's Casing
quests.text: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: The Torch of Retribution
quests.text: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.

quests.name: The Torch of Retribution
quests.text: Take the Torch of Retribution.

quests.name: Squire Maltrake
quests.text: Speak with Squire Maltrake.

quests.name: Trinkets...
quests.text: Open the chest.

quests.name: The Undermarket
quests.text: Speak with Vizzklick in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
quests.text: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.  Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

quests.name: Look at the Size of It!
quests.text: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

quests.name: What the Flux?
quests.text: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Shadoweaver
quests.text: Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.

quests.name: The Undermarket
quests.text: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.

quests.name: Release Them
quests.text: Find the Mysterious Artifact being guarded by the Twilight's Hammer Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the Searing Gorge and bring it to the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.

quests.name: Set Them Ablaze!
quests.text: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.

quests.name: Rise, Obsidion!
quests.text: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.

quests.name: Elemental Leatherworking
quests.text: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.  Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.  The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood
Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron
Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather
